result.title: Width and Depth Limits Commute During Training
result.summary: Recent work established that the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits of residual networks commute at initialization when residual branches are scaled by $1/\sqrt{depth}$. In particular, the network output converges to the same limit whether width and depth tend to infinity sequentially or jointly. We extend this commutativity result to training in linear residual networks. Under the same $1/\sqrt{depth}$ residual-branch scaling (Depth-$μ$P) and the $μ$P width parameterization, we prove that, for any fixed number of gradient-descent steps with gradient clipping, the network output converges in $L^2$ along every joint width--depth growth path as both width and depth tend to infinity. Consequently, the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits commute throughout any finite training horizon. Without gradient clipping, the corresponding $L^2$ convergence does not hold in general, but we establish the weaker convergence in probability.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在线性残差网络中研究宽度与深度无穷极限在训练中是否可交换：在 Depth-μP 分支缩放与 μP 宽度参数化下，证明带梯度裁剪时网络输出沿任意联合宽度–深度增长路径 L² 收敛，并指出无裁剪时仅有依概率收敛。
AI.relevance_reason: 无穷深度极限与深度缩放的收敛性分析，可能为循环式 latent 推理的计算深度外推及深层训练稳定性提供概念参照，但论文限于线性残差网络、未涉及多模态推理或状态内容，可供核查迁移价值有限。
